content:
Aisha: FYI customer #5172 seeing mid-stream disconnects when switching to phone hotspot. They get a partial chunk then the client closes. Trace: trace-5172-zz. App v2.1.2 Android.

Devon: can you paste repro steps + client logs? is this via our JS SDK or raw SSE?

Aisha: JS SDK v0.9. Repro steps:
1) start streaming generation
2) enable phone hotspot from another device
3) client connects to hotspot -> within a few seconds stream emits partial then 'close'.
Logs:
```json
{ "err": "socket closed by client", "code": 1006 }
```
server log snippet: `stream: conn 0x7f abort`

Devon: hmmm. Does token get rotated at that time? any 401s in server logs?

Aisha: No 401s. Server shows `keepalive received` then nothing. Client logs show network flapping. Customer worried they were billed for the partial tokens.

Alex: pinging SRE - could be carrier/proxy idle timeouts on interface handover. @Devon try increasing `keepaliveIntervalMs` to 15000 and repro? Also check websocket/SSE token TTL around the time of swap.

Devon: will try. Can you capture exact SSE frames around the abort? maybe enable verbose pipe logging and share. Also which model/route?

Aisha: model=redwood/longgen-8B, route `/v1/stream/generate`. Minimal repro + stripped logs attached to ticket: https://support.example.com/t/5172

Devon: quick client workaround: enable automatic reconnect (EventSource reconnect) and retry on close. Note SSE doesn't natively resume KV cache so generation restarts. For billing: we should consider server dedupe/credit for aborted token windows. cc @product.

Casebot: Escalation created and assigned. Priority: high. Assignee: Devon.

Mobot: deploy-note: rolled back proxy idle-timeout change at 2024-11-08T03:12Z — might be related.

Aisha: customer can reproduce consistently. Keeping them on hold for a repro build.

Devon: repro confirmed on emulator w/ hotspot toggle. Observed client sends TCP FIN on interface change; server continues sending for ~200ms then connection is gone. Likely OS-level socket close on network switch. Trying heartbeat (10s) + longer keepalive to keep the connection alive during handover. Will report back. :thumbsup:

Aisha: thanks — we'll provide the heartbeat workaround and file a billing credit note if we detect aborted token billing.

Devon: follow-ups: collect pcap around the switch, compare with carrier NAT timeouts, and add a small server-side guard to avoid charging for tokens after immediate client-initiated close.

Aisha: added to ticket timeline. I'll ping customer when we have a patched client or clearer mitigation.
